stories.title: Nederlanders moeten voor acht dagen eten in huis hebben, waarschuwt onderzoek

en.title: Dutch people should keep eight days of food in stock, research warns
en.summary: Research by the Clingendael Institute and Erasmus University recommends Dutch households maintain an eight-day food supply, compared to the current three-day guideline.

stories.title: CNN, Politico en MS NOW volgens Trump ‘per direct’ uit Witte Huis verbannen, maar gevolgen nog onduidelijk

en.title: CNN, Politico and MSNOW banned from White House by Trump 'immediately', but consequences unclear
en.summary: Trump announced an immediate ban on three news outlets from White House access, though further details about implementation remain unclear.

stories.title: Twee arrestaties om mensensmokkel en uitbuiting bij Indiase restaurants

en.title: Two arrests for human trafficking and exploitation at Indian restaurants
en.summary: Dutch labor inspection authorities arrested two restaurant owners suspected of human trafficking and exploitation, with Europol reporting over seventy victims across eight Indian restaurants.

stories.title: CNN, MSNOW en Politico door Trump uit Witte Huis geweerd om 'nepnieuws'

en.title: Trump bans CNN, MSNOW and Politico from White House for 'fake news'
en.summary: President Trump revoked White House access for three news organizations, claiming they spread false information about him, his administration and the United States.

stories.title: Trump gaat CNN en andere grote media uit Witte Huis weren

en.title: Trump to ban CNN and other major media from White House
en.summary: Donald Trump announced he will exclude major news organizations CNN, MSNBC, and Politico from the White House, claiming they spread false news without providing supporting evidence.

stories.title: Gehackt laboratorium mag weer bevolkingsonderzoek doen

en.title: Hacked laboratory allowed to resume population screening
en.summary: Clinical Diagnostics, which was hacked last year resulting in data theft from 850,000 people, received permission to resume cervical cancer screening operations after security improvements were completed.

stories.title: Sarcofaag Harald verwijst naar zijn liefde voor zeilen - en Vikingbegrafenissen

en.title: King Harald's sarcophagus reflects his passion for sailing and Viking burials
en.summary: Norway's royal family revealed details about the olive-green sarcophagus of deceased King Harald, designed to resemble a ship's hull referencing his love of sailing and ancient Viking burial traditions.

stories.title: Het was voor zijn ‘familie en toekomstige kinderen’ dat Rini H. een tafelblad en een putdeksel naar de politie gooide

en.title: Man threw objects at police during right-wing riots for his "family and future children"
en.summary: A defendant in court cited concerns about Netherlands' future and housing shortage to explain his participation in right-wing riots involving fire-setting and police confrontations, while others blamed personal problems or substance use.

stories.title: Kabinet wil 250 zieke en gewonde Gazaanse kinderen naar Jordanië halen

en.title: Cabinet wants to bring 250 sick and wounded Gaza children to Jordan
en.summary: The Dutch government is allocating 6 million euros to evacuate 250 sick and severely wounded children from Gaza for treatment in Jordan through the World Health Organization, with additional funding to support aid organizations.

stories.title: Kabinet wil 250 zieke Gazaanse kinderen laten evacueren naar Jordanië voor medische zorg

en.title: Cabinet wants 250 sick Gaza children evacuated to Jordan for medical care
en.summary: The government is facilitating the evacuation of 250 sick children from Gaza to Jordan for medical treatment.

stories.title: Nederland trekt geld uit voor zieke kinderen in Gaza, maar haalt ze niet hierheen

en.title: Netherlands allocates funds for sick children in Gaza, but will not bring them here
en.summary: The Dutch government is providing funding to enable 250 Gaza children to receive treatment in Jordan, while currently declining to bring patients to the Netherlands.

stories.title: Kabinet regelt evacuatie 250 zieke kinderen uit Gaza naar Jordanië, ondanks bestand ‘amper’ zorg beschikbaar in Gaza

en.title: Cabinet arranges evacuation of 250 sick children from Gaza to Jordan, despite ceasefire with 'barely' medical care available in Gaza
en.summary: The Dutch government is allocating 12 million euros for medical assistance to Palestinian children and organizing the evacuation of 250 sick children from Gaza to Jordan.
